description: Punto de encuentro vendedores. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto para la Economía Social - IPES. Conjunto de datos geoespaciales definidos por el Instituto Para la Economía Social IPES como espacio público dotado con mobiliario urbano, que permite una función articuladora entre el sistema del espacio público y el Sistema Integrado de Transporte Masivo; está compuesto por un espacio abierto y un espacio con mobiliario; tal como, ciclo parqueaderos y servicio ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto para la Economía Social - IPES. Its tags are Economia, Encuentro, IPES, ideca. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GPKG, HTML, JSON. The portal shows 2020-10-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
